## Result

- Skill: design-review.
- Review status: approved.
- Review ID: design-review-r7.
- Exact package: Design, System, Workflow, retained Target-native init, and Review and Closeout.
- Prior four members remain unchanged from r6; RC is the exact scoped correction subject.
- Direction: unchanged approved proposal plus explicit user current-authority refinement.
- Material findings / correction targets: none.
- Recording status: targeted v2 review.record.
- Next owner: Route; no model, work or route edits by reviewer.
- Claim limits: Design coherence only; no final Code Review, Verify, push, PR update or completion approval.

## Independent current package assessment

The explicit user refinement is a bounded current-authority clarification, not a return to runtime compatibility design. Record Format RF-SR-06 already retires all v1 runtime acceptance, and CLI-SR-10/18 plus its current/retired discovery and transport clauses already implement that selected contract. Those models require no changes. The retained explicit-recording-v1 model-validation marker and targeted-recording-v1 transport name version independent surfaces; their spelling never selects stored v1.

The actual RC diff removes the contrary current weaker-v1-reader/rollback statements and references those existing owners. Earlier v1 bytes, vocabulary, approval subjects and procedural context remain archival without conversion or fabricated origin. The extraction maps retain source identities and decision meaning; introductory/drafting/follow-on descriptions distinguish historical scope from current adoption and activity. Model conventions/mapping now reference Design while Workflow retains coordination. No new RC policy, gate, schema, runtime reader or permission is introduced, and installation remains separate from customer adoption.

Independent Python extraction compared all18 RC-SR rows and all5 RC-DEC rows against d62fd3fa: each is byte-identical. Marker spelling is unchanged. The compatibility scenario is clarified consistently with RF-SR-06, without adding an installer/runtime behavior or weakening historical preservation. Actual diff and link targets support source ownership coherence; author boundary/prose/readability and link checks are inspection evidence, not approval. The45 length warnings are reported, not converted into semantic findings. Existing13 historical installer prose errors retain their previous scoped limitation and are unrelated to this correction.

The complete prior four-member engineering contract and composition basis remains applicable because its exact subjects are unchanged. Adding the corrected RC consumer resolves a stale dependency reference without changing shared assessment policy or duplicating Record Format/Design authority. RC's policy remains the governing assessment dependency for the assembled system. Its existing independent-assessment/failed-proof/reassessment obligations now apply to this exact revision, not its former subject. Earlier Design r6 and historical RC extraction judgments retain their original subjects and meaning; this fresh r7 supplies the current package assessment. No old review is retargeted.

## Independence

Concrete independent nonauthor reviewer /root/independent_design_review. Primary-agent authored the scoped RC clarification following the explicit user request. Reviewer edited no governed Design/plan/package contribution and independently assessed current contracts, actual diff, preserved requirements/decisions and five exact subjects.
